whatsappMessage:
Hi Team JASHN,

I noticed your restaurant & banquet has exceptional 4.6★ reviews from over 2,900 customers in Saguna More, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and party bookings.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, banquet inquiry, aur special menu showcase integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/jashn

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team JASHN, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant aur banquet ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, banquet event inquiry, and your strong 4.6-star reviews from Saguna More. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menus, actual venue photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
